node.statement: Since tau <= 1/256, one has (4 + 8t)/tau >= 4/tau >= 1024 > 6 >= A, so the regime-(ii) bound is the weaker of the two and therefore covers both cases; every nonactor support fiber Q satisfies the single uniform bound |x_Q| <= X(tau) := (4 + 8*tau^2)/tau.
